prompt: Build for this brief: A public information service; people find reliable guidance quickly. Use Burgundy and Rose: page #FFF8FA, text #48232E, accent #9D244E, secondary surface #F7DBE5, text on accent #FFFFFF. Set headings in Bagnard and reading text in Cotham Sans; characterful display serif with understated body. Composition: Narrow index beside an unframed detail pane; index becomes a menu on mobile. Use body 18px, heading 36px, line height 1.6, reading measure at most 56ch, gap 16px, content width at most 1280px and item radius 4px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
